title: PPO on the micro hook (stochastic 25-32-7 policy, on-policy, critic + GAE)
source: thread 'Deep Q-learning', 16 Oct (user: y si probamos un PPO)
hypothesis: on-policy PPO starting from the rules learns deviations that beat the control on v100

history.note: 15 iterations x 600 games. Learned kite 4->11%, back off 4->9%, engage 3->0%, deaths/game 4.15->3.21. v100 vs control: sampled 58-95 p=0.003, greedy 51-67 p=0.17 (fewer deaths 1596 vs 1830, fewer maps). Report /mnt/project-files/analysis/dqn-2026-10-16/README.md
